question: **Direction: Select the MISSPELT word.**
solution:
The correct answer is** "Toleranse."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **"Tolerance."**
 
• The incorrect spelling **"Toleranse"** has letter** "s" **instead of **"c."**
 
• The correct pronunciation is** "TOL-er-uhns".**
 
• The word means the ability to endure or accept something without resistance. (सहिष्‍णुता, सहनशीलता)
 
 
• **Example**: *This period in history is not noted for its religious **tolerance**__.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "Preference"**, means a greater liking for one option over another. (एक की अपेक्षा दूसरी में अधिक रुचि; (किसी को किसी पर) अधिमान्‍यता, तरजीह)
 
• **Option 2, "Avoidance"**, means the act of staying away from something or someone. (बचाव, परिहार)
 
• **Option 3, "Correction"**, means the act of making something right or correcting a mistake. (त्रुटि-शोधन, सुधार कार्य)

38:Tbfe,

The correct answer is **"consequences."**
